**Context.** Observed on 2026-10-04 while reading this README for the Intro to Cyber repository. Check each point again before editing.
- The quick start tells people to clone `https://github.com/AquilaCyber/CTF-Master.git`, but the repository is `Aquilacyber/Aquilacyber-CTF`. The site's own "Challenges" link still points to the earlier name, `Zero-Day-Arena`, which redirects.
- The community section lists alturacyber.com/aquilacyber and a `.com` support address, while the agreed main link is https://www.aquilacyber.org/.

**Fix.** Use the current repository name in the clone command, point the community links at aquilacyber.org, and update the "Challenges" link on the website.

**Done when.** A new contributor can clone the repository by copying the command from the README.
